Claim amendment · 2026-11-15T04:25Z · to claim 6889088903. `File surface:` now also takes `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts` (`formatSummaryLabel`) with a new pin test beside it, and `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, limited to one added export, `summaryDeclaresCurrency`. `Clause-②:` becomes `yes (widening)` on `@object-ui/fields`; a contract record is owed before landing.

Reason (dev's read on `d95ddebc`, live showcase `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_expense_report`): the summary field IS served with `scale: 2`, so the ui half proceeds. The footer total is formatted in `useColumnSummary.ts` `formatSummaryLabel`, where a `summary` column falls to the plain `toLocaleString` default and never reads `scale`. The list cell already decides money by `summaryDeclaresCurrency` (`@object-ui/fields`, imported there, not exported) and else draws a number at `resolveFieldScale`; the footer reuses that same predicate and the existing currency / number arms, so no second formatter.

Accepted reading of the order's "currency format when its source is currency": the spec's `currencyConfig` (absent on a summary = no currency) and the cell decide money by the summary's own declaration, not its source type, and the footer follows the cell. HotCRM's `paid_amount` (no `currencyConfig`, `scale: 2`) will read `230,000.00`, matching its cell. Outside every other seat's live files (ui seat 1's #33548 edits `ObjectGrid.tsx` `buildMobileCardRenderer`; the serial hold on `ObjectGrid.tsx` stands). Nothing else in the claim changes.

## Cross-card note from #33659 · 2026-11-15T07:11Z

⛔ Not a claim; nothing changes on this card's surface.

PR #33710 (#33659, spec seat 4) makes `ui/packages/fields/src/currency.ts#summaryDeclaresCurrency` answer true for a summary declaring `currencyMode: 'dynamic'`, which the spec admits only over a stored home-currency amount. This card's footer decides money by that same predicate, so once both PRs are on `main` a home-currency roll-up reaches the list footer through this card's code. The check owed after both merge, by whichever seat lands second: the footer total of such a roll-up shows the tenant (home) currency with no record (`resolveFieldCurrency` answers the tenant default for any non-`record` config). Contract review of #33710: 6890873219, section ③ (c).

## After-both-merge check from the cross-card note · 2026-11-15T09:51Z

⛔ Not a claim; the card stays closed.

Both PRs are on `main` (#33710 merged 08:57:19Z, #33728 at 08:59Z). The landing record for #33728 did not take up the check the cross-card note owed, so spec seat 4 closes it. This is a code reading at `origin/main` `a557fa38`; no new test was run.

| Step | Reading on `main` |
| --- | --- |
| Footer's money decision | `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts`: `colType = column?.type === 'summary' ? summaryValueType(column) : column?.type`. `summaryValueType` answers `'currency'` when `summaryDeclaresCurrency(column)` is true (:375). Since #33710, that is true for `currencyMode: 'dynamic'`. |
| Currency code | The `'currency'` arm calls `resolveFieldCurrency(column, tenantDefault)` from `@object-ui/i18n` (:444) with no record. For any config that is not `record`, that function returns `field.currency`, then the `fixed` code, then `defaultCurrency`, then **the tenant default** (`ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts:283-289`). A `dynamic` summary carries none of the first three. |
| Result | The footer total of a home-currency roll-up is drawn in the tenant (home) currency with no record, which is what the note required. This matches the record face and the list cell that #33710 pinned in `summaryFaces.homeRollup-33659.test.tsx`. |

The footer itself has no pin for the `dynamic` case. If one is wanted, it belongs to the ui lane and is not owed by this card.
